notes.title: RETROWAVE '84 JUNE 2025 DEVELOPMENT NEWS/UPDATE!
notes.content:
Hey all, so far many of the technical hurdles remaining have been resolved, as well as new features/improvements have been added such as a much more flexible FOV slider, as well as a speed run time option for those who are up for challenges such as that! Both will be featured in the final demo version along with the full release! Work after this month will involve getting the game deck verified! As always, thanks for continued support and following, and will see you all next month, as always, the public community discord is always open, as well as frequent updates on both X/Twitter as well as my YouTube channel! Take cares!

PS: Here's a handy link to my YT channel! https://www.youtube.com/@GameDevKS

notes.title: Monthly dev update - Feb 2025
notes.content:
Hey all, back for this months development update! I've been working away at refining the weapon roster further, and can confirm that this game will have some very cool explosive weapons added!

Still a way to go, but plenty of progress is being made! Till next months update, take care!

- KS

notes.title: MONTHLY DEV UPDATE - NOVEMBER 2024
notes.content:
Hey all back for another monthly update post! So currently with Retrowave '84 I'm going to try and kill two birds with one stone as they say, and get it both Steam Deck compatible and controller/gamepad supported soon, there's still quite a bit to do on top of that however the game internally is currently able to be played from start to finish! As planned from the get go there will be achievements in this game also! This means it'll be in development a little longer since I want to get this is as polished as it can as well as due to the fact I plan to give you guys the full experience I always wanted from the get go, and make it worth the wait!!

Until the next monthly update, take care and thanks for the continued feedback and support! - KS

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42810370/34a667099f39dd650aa557a33d1bbe409d4c2d65.png[/img]

notes.title: September 2024 Monthy Development Update!
notes.content:
Hi all! Just a quick update on plans for Retrowave '84, as development continues to progress nicely, I was able to drop a patch to add launch options for those having trouble opening the demo to get it running. For those still having issues I have one more planned patch but that will be nearer launch of Retrowave '84, which is getting ever closer! 

Also Retrowave '84 will be part of the Fulqrum Boomstock Steam event, so keep an eye out for that this month! As always, this game continues to go from strength to strength and will be something special upon release! Till then, take care! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42810370/bf56d66ef576ff19f26956f3506e508ca6db0904.png[/img]

notes.title: RETROWAVE 84 NEW DEMO UPDATE OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hey all, the brand new demo update is live, a few things include...

- Brand New Level
- More Enemies
- More Teases/Reveals
- Streamlined/improved the Pause menu UI
- Refined the slowmo
- Improved weapon SFX/FX
- Bug fixes
- Brand new intro 
- More polish to previous demo levels
- much more!!

This version is listed as 0.83, will likely be a while before to next one as that will almost be in time for release, enjoy the new demo! As always any technical issues/feedback there is a pinned thread on the Steam Forums, or you can reach out to me directly by joining the community discord: discord.gg/Q9dhTkmvPb


Thanks for all support so far, and I'll continue to post monthly development updates on Steam to keep you all in the loop. 

- KS98

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42810370/a84f8e87fa7e3b67b7b99e666fd09f882471c046.png[/img]
